name: Lakehouse Query Window
description: On the data exploration front, the new Lakehouse Query Explorer introduces a streamlined, in-context query experience directly within the Lakehouse. Users can write and run Spark SQL queries right from the Lakehouse explorer to quickly discover and analyze data, with intelligent suggestions and real-time error prevention all without needing to navigate to a notebook. Results can be saved as Spark Views, visualized as charts, filtered, sorted, and downloaded, with rich contextual information throughout. When deeper analysis is required, code can be seamlessly promoted into a notebook for more complex processing, bridging the gap between ad-hoc exploration and production-grade data engineering.
